The '''Ghoba system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Chitarghar sector/Legends|Chitarghar sector]], a part of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of [[Ghoba rice]].<ref name="LandosCommandos">{{Tales|5|Lando's Commandos: On Eagles' Wings}}</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Ghoba rice]]|system=Ghoba [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Ghoba system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square K-15.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
